methods.name: Operator or station-network point
methods.description: Match the CSV station number or distinctive name and its location to a published store record. Use that record's station, display, or routing point. The identity checks also use the street, city/state, or highway/exit when available.

methods.name: Explicitly labeled operator-directory extract
methods.description: Use a dated AllThePlaces extract of an operator's own location feed. Match the station identity and locality. Keep the original operator URL and snapshot reference. An extract is a delivery mechanism, not an independent second source.

methods.name: Historical identity bridge to an operator point
methods.description: Join the original station number/name to its published street in an older directory or government retailer record. Match that same street to the current operator. This handles renumbering and rebranding without assuming that similar store numbers or nearby branches are interchangeable.

methods.name: Premises review and conflict resolution
methods.description: Reconcile station identities and conflicting points using scripted source checks and individual property reviews. Some records document imagery inspection or a selected canopy point; the source label does not establish manual inspection.

methods.name: Published point after property review
methods.description: Resolve the original identity using published station records. Read the exact named map listing and inspect the property. Retain its published coordinate unchanged rather than estimating a new point from imagery.

methods.name: Published street matched to mapped premises
methods.description: Obtain a numeric street address from a station, fleet, or government directory. Match it and the station identity to an OpenStreetMap fuel, shop, or named premises feature. Use that feature's coordinate, not the street-geocoder search anchor. The record preserves which kind of feature supplied the point.

methods.name: Fleet-fuel locator point
methods.description: Match station name or store number and locality to a CFN/Fuelman diesel station record. Use its station coordinate after reconciliation. Both locators share a backend, so their agreement does not count as independent corroboration.

methods.name: Direct OpenStreetMap station match
methods.description: Match a distinctive station name or brand plus store number to a mapped fuel feature in the correct state and locality. Reject ambiguous matches. City boundaries or city search anchors constrain the search; their centroids are not used as the station point.

methods.name: Federal station GPS record
methods.description: Match a published station street to an Alternative Fuels Data Center premises record. Use that station's GPS coordinate. This is different from accepting a generic USDA retailer or EPA tank coordinate without premises checks.

methods.name: CAT Scale host-station property
methods.description: Match CAT Scale's named host station, city/state, and road/exit. Use the published scale coordinate on that station property. It locates the truck-stop premises, not necessarily its fuel canopy or entrance.

methods.name: Archived operator-network coordinate
methods.description: Match the original numbered station and city/state to an archived Pilot network list. Retain its published coordinate when accepted by reconciliation. The source year is preserved; these few points have greater freshness uncertainty.

status_exclusion_groups.description: Property advertised as a former gas station

tomtom_search.independent_context_snapshot: Final pre-merge audit of all 1,109 search-target records; includes held identities and city-only-name guards.
tomtom_search.notes: TomTom place content and coordinates were not retained. Final coordinates use independently cached mapped fuel features. The three independent-audit-only acceptances did not require a provider match. The checkpoint failed before request 450 was sent; resumed from 449 completed requests.
